T021-C01.matches_public_best: not asserted; the source value is rounded and the decimal coordinates are rationalized onto the sphere
limitations: The published coordinate file has finite decimal precision. human.py interprets each decimal as an exact rational, then maps it to an exact unit-sphere point by stereographic projection. This slightly changes the geometry.
The reproduced score is the checker's conservative upper bound for the rationalized witness, not the source's rounded value.
The CCD table records a numerical candidate and does not prove global optimality.
The latest author discussion dated 2026-10-27 says N=32 will need a new idea for a proof: https://www.vals.ai/blogs/thomson-exposition.

The matching AlphaEvolve problem is repository problem 33 at fixed commit 8f447457957deac61e28bf1676746f0753b3b2f8 and paper section 6.18. No AlphaEvolve score is carried over; same-parameter cross-run verification remains outstanding.
